response: Saved Views is available today, giving every team a faster way to organize and revisit their most important work. Instead of rebuilding filters and sort orders each time you open a project, you can now capture the exact combination of filters, grouping, and sorting you rely on and return to it with a single click. Saved Views is included in all paid plans, so there is no separate add-on or upgrade required to start using it. Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to set up dedicated views for different projects, clients, sprints, or reporting needs without worrying about running out of space. Views can be shared with a team, making it easy to align everyone around the same filtered perspective, whether that is a sprint board, a list of overdue tasks, or a client dashboard. We built this feature so customers can navigate complex projects more quickly. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
